## Wstępne histogramy

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

colnames(dane)

for (kolumna in colnames(dane)) {
  if (is.numeric(dane[[kolumna]])) {
    plot <- ggplot(dane, aes(x = .data[[kolumna]])) +
      geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
      theme_minimal()
    print(plot)
  }
}
```

**Wnioski**:

- Dane odstające dla wielu kolumn
- Niezbilanoswanie danych
- Istniejące braki danych
- Błędny wiek (poniżej 18 lat)

# Analiza

## Przygotowanie danych

```{r}
dane$X <- NULL

dane <- subset(dane, age >= 18)

dane$MonthlyIncome[is.na(dane$MonthlyIncome)] <- median(dane$MonthlyIncome, na.rm = TRUE)
dane$NumberOfDependents[is.na(dane$NumberOfDependents)] <- median(dane$NumberOfDependents, na.rm = TRUE)

df_cleaned <- as.data.frame(lapply(dane, function(x) {
  if(is.numeric(x)) {
    limit <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    x[x > limit] <- limit
  }
  return(x)
}))

saveRDS(df_cleaned, "data/cs-cleaned.rds")
dane <- readRDS("data/cs-cleaned.rds")

```

## Analiza jednowymiarowa

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

colnames(dane)

for (kolumna in colnames(dane)) {

    plot <- ggplot(dane, aes(x = .data[[kolumna]])) +
```

## Analiza wielowymiarowa

```{r}
for (kolumna in colnames(dane)) {
  if (is.numeric(dane[[kolumna]]) && kolumna != "SeriousDlqin2yrs") {
    
    p <- ggplot(dane, aes(x = .data[[kolumna]], fill = as.factor(SeriousDlqin2yrs))) +
      # after_stat(density) sprawia, że wykres jest znormalizowany
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
                     bins = 50, 
                     alpha = 0.5,           # Przezroczystość, żeby widzieć obie grupy
                     position = "identity") + # Nakładanie na siebie
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste("Znormalizowany rozkład:", kolumna),
           x = kolumna,
           y = "Gęstość (Prawdopodobieństwo)",
           fill = "SeriousDlqin2yrs")
    
    print(p)
  }
}
```

# Proces tworzenia modelu

Podział na zbiór treningowy i testowy

```{r}
set.seed(42)
indeksy <- sample(1:nrow(dane), 0.8 * nrow(dane))
train_data <- dane[indeksy, ]
test_data <- dane[-indeksy, ]
```

## Oversampling SMOTE

```{r}
library(smotefamily)

features_train <- train_data[, -which(names(train_data) == "SeriousDlqin2yrs")]
target_train <- train_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs

features_train_scaled <- scale(features_train)
train_center <- attr(features_train_scaled, "scaled:center")
train_scale <- attr(features_train_scaled, "scaled:scale")

smote_result <- SMOTE(as.data.frame(features_train_scaled), target_train, K = 5, dup_size = 0)
train_smote <- smote_result$data

colnames(train_smote)[ncol(train_smote)] <- "SeriousDlqin2yrs"
train_smote$SeriousDlqin2yrs <- as.numeric(train_smote$SeriousDlqin2yrs)
```

## Model XGBoost

```{r}
library(xgboost)

features_test_scaled <- scale(test_data[, -which(names(test_data) == "SeriousDlqin2yrs")], 
                              center = train_center, 
                              scale = train_scale)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(train_smote[, -which(names(train_smote) == "SeriousDlqin2yrs")]),
  label = train_smote$SeriousDlqin2yrs
)

dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(features_test_scaled),
  label = test_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs
)

params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.1
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 100,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  print_every_n = 10
)

xgb.save(xgb_model, "model_credit_scoring.model")
saveRDS(list(center = train_center, scale = train_scale), "scaling_params.rds")
```

```{r}
library(ROCR)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)

# --- 1) Przygotuj test w tej samej postaci jak przy treningu ---
# (czyli: skalowanie testu parametrami z treningu)

features_test <- test_data[, setdiff(names(test_data), "SeriousDlqin2yrs")]

features_test_scaled <- scale(
  features_test,
  center = train_center,
  scale  = train_scale
)

dtest_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(features_test_scaled))

# --- 2) Predykcja ---
preds <- predict(xgb_model, dtest_matrix)

# --- 3) Krzywa Precision-Recall ---
pred_obj <- ROCR::prediction(preds, test_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs)
perf_pr  <- ROCR::performance(pred_obj, "prec", "rec")

df_pr <- data.frame(
  Recall    = perf_pr@x.values[[1]],
  Precision = perf_pr@y.values[[1]]
)
df_pr <- na.omit(df_pr)

# --- 4) Punkt dla wybranego progu (threshold) ---
thresh <- 0.5
preds_class <- ifelse(preds >= thresh, 1, 0)

# recall = TP / (TP + FN)
pt_rec <- sum(preds_class == 1 & test_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs == 1) /
  sum(test_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs == 1)

# precision = TP / (TP + FP)
pt_prec <- sum(preds_class == 1 & test_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs == 1) /
  sum(preds_class == 1)

# --- 5) Wykres PR ---
ggplot(df_pr, aes(x = Recall, y = Precision)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pt_rec, y = pt_prec), color = "red", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = sprintf("Krzywa Precision-Recall (próg = %.2f)", thresh))

# --- 6) Confusion matrix dla tego samego progu ---
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
  data = factor(preds_class, levels = c(0, 1)),
  reference = factor(test_data$SeriousDlqin2yrs, levels = c(0, 1)),
  positive = "1"
)

print(conf_matrix)
```
